description: The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor setup with 3 displays and a dropdown menu expanded with options to duplicate, extend, or show only on specific monitors.

Windows 11 Settings app showing System > Display settings with a dropdown menu open for multiple displays configuration, displaying options to duplicate or extend desktop across three detected monitors (labeled 1, 2|3).

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing a multi-monitor setup with three displays (1, 2|3) and a dropdown menu expanded with options to duplicate or extend the desktop across displays 2 and 3.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor configuration with 3 displays where the user has opened the "Multiple displays" dropdown menu revealing options like "Duplicate desktop on 2 and 3," "Extend desktop," and "Show only on" specific monitors.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open on the Display settings page, showing display configuration options including brightness, scale, resolution, and multiple display arrangement with monitor preview diagrams.
